title: Leaks by Installments: Cross-Session Answer Disclosure in LLM Tutors and a Ledger-Based Defense
abstract: arXiv:2611.31429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tutors built on large language models (LLMs) are told not to give away answers, but a learner does not have to ask for the answer all at once. Existing safeguards judge each reply within the current conversation, so a learner can open a new session, reword the problem, or request a worked solution to the same problem with different numbers. We call this cross-session disclosure and propose a defense: a persistent, per-learner disclosure ledger. For every problem a learner brings, the system builds a typed solution graph. Before a reply is released, a gate matches the reply's own content, not the learner's wording, against the ledger by result values and by type-labeled solution structure, then computes which steps the learner could now derive. The reply is withheld if that set reaches the final answer or exceeds a budget. In a simulation of 3,000 problems, the ledger reduced leakage through renumbered practice variants from 100% to 10.

translated_title: 分期泄露：LLM辅导系统中的跨会话答案泄露及基于账本的防御
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的辅导系统被告知不要泄露答案，但学习者并不需要一次性索要答案。现有的安全防护措施仅在当前对话范围内评判每次回复，因此学习者可以开启新会话、重新措辞表述问题，或对同一问题使用不同数字请求完整的解题过程。我们将这种现象称为跨会话泄露，并提出一种防御方法：为每个学习者维护一个持久的泄露账本。对于学习者提出的每个问题，系统会构建一个带类型的解题图。在回复发布之前，一个门控机制将回复自身的内容（而非学习者的措辞）按结果值和带类型标签的解题结构与账本进行匹配，然后计算学习者此时能够推导出哪些步骤。如果该步骤集合能够到达最终答案或超出预算，则拒绝该回复。在3000个问题的模拟实验中，该账本将通过改编数字的练习变体导致的泄露从100%降低到10%。
tldr: 本文提出一种为每个学习者维护持久化泄露账本的防御机制，通过类型化解题图与门控匹配检测跨会话答案泄露，将模拟实验中通过改编数字练习变体产生的泄露率从100%降至10%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a persistent per-learner disclosure ledger defense against cross-session answer disclosure in LLM tutors, using typed solution graphs and a gate that matches replies against past disclosures by result values and solution structure, reducing leakage from renumbered practice variants from 100% to 10% in a 3,000-problem simulation.
